title: 第5章 没落的贵族第6章 黑色切割者
slug: 转生反派贵族妈妈们都太爱我了
content_zh:
;;
卫兵连滚带爬地去推大门，嘴里语无伦次地喊着，甚至忘了先去通报。
庄园内瞬间乱成一锅粥。
没过多久，主楼的大门被推开。
一群人衣衫不整地涌了出来。
为首的是个身材干瘦的老头，穿着一件明显不太合身的旧礼服，扣子都扣错了位。
他身后跟着个胖妇人，还有几个探头探脑的年轻人。
德莱厄斯家族的格林男爵，凯瑟琳的父亲。
马车稳稳停下。
侍从跳下来，放下脚凳，拉开车门。
肖恩率先走了下来。
黑色的长筒靴踩在满是落叶的地面上，发出清脆的响声。
“肖……肖恩少爷？”格林浑浊的老眼瞪得老大，像是看见了鬼。
在他的印象里，这位少爷可是出了名的难伺候，而且极其厌恶凯瑟琳。
怎么会亲自送凯瑟琳回来？
难道是来退货的？
想到这里，格林男爵的冷汗顺着额头就流了下来。
如果是退货，那当年收的那笔巨额礼金岂不是要吐出来？
那可是早就花光了啊！
“这就是德莱厄斯家的待客之道？”肖恩没有理会老头的惊恐，只是淡淡地弹了弹衣袖上并不存在的灰尘。

“让凯瑟琳oo在风口里吹着？”
格林男爵一愣，随即反应过来，腰弯得比刚才那个卫兵还要低：“不不不，是我们失礼了！快，快请进！”
肖恩没动。
他转身，向着车厢内伸出手。
众目睽睽之下，一只戴着蕾丝手套的纤细手掌搭在了他的手上。
随后，盛装打扮的凯瑟琳缓缓走了出来。
那一刻，整个德莱厄斯家族的人都安静了。
太耀眼了。
无论是那身价值连城的丝绸长裙，还是那脖子上硕大的红宝石项链，亦或是凯瑟琳此刻那种被人精心呵护出来的从容气质，都和这个破败的院子格格不入。
她不像是个被嫌弃的继室，倒像是个受尽宠爱的王后。
“父亲，母亲。”凯瑟琳站定，微微欠身，礼仪无可挑剔。
格林张大了嘴，半天合不拢。
这……这是他那个只会哭哭啼啼的女儿？
“怎么，不认识了？”肖恩冷笑一声，手臂自然地揽过凯瑟琳的肩膀，“还是说，格林男爵觉得我带来的礼物不够分量？”
他打了个响指。
content_en:
;;
The guard crawled on the ground to push the door open, shouting incoherently, and even forgot to report it first.
The manor instantly became a mess.
Not long after, the door to the main building was pushed open.
A group of disheveled people came out.
The leader was a skinny old man, wearing an old dress that obviously didn't fit well, and the buttons were buttoned in the wrong place.
Behind him was a fat woman and several young men who were looking around.
Baron Green of the Darius family, Catherine's father.
The carriage stopped steadily.
The attendant jumped down, put down the footstool, and opened the door.
Sean walked down first.
The black boots made a crisp sound when they stepped on the ground covered with fallen leaves.
"Xiao...Master Xiaonian?" Green's turbid old eyes widened, as if he had seen a ghost.
In his impression, this young master was notoriously difficult to maintain and disliked Catherine extremely.
How could he send Catherine back in person?
Are you here for a return?
Thinking of this, Baron Green's cold sweat flowed down his forehead.
If it's a return, wouldn't the huge gift money received that year have to be spit out?
That has been spent long ago!
"Is this how the Darius family treats guests?" Sean ignored the old man's fear and simply flicked the non-existent dust on his sleeves.
"Let Catherine oo blow in the wind?"
Baron Greene was stunned for a moment, and then he realized what he was doing. He bent even lower than the guard just now: "No, no, no, we are rude! Come on, please come in!"
Sean didn't move.
He turned around and stretched out his hand towards the car.
In full view of everyone, a slender palm wearing a lace glove placed on his hand.
Then, Catherine, dressed in finery, slowly walked out.
At that moment, the entire Darius family fell silent.
So dazzling.
Whether it was the priceless silk dress, the huge ruby ​​necklace around her neck, or the calm temperament that Catherine had been carefully cared for at the moment, they were all incompatible with this dilapidated yard.
She doesn't look like a despised step-brother, but like a well-loved queen.
"Father, mother." Catherine stood still, bowed slightly, and her etiquette was impeccable.
Green opened his mouth wide and couldn't close it for a long time.
This...is this his daughter who can only cry?
"What, you don't know me anymore?" Sean sneered, and his arm naturally wrapped around Catherine's shoulders, "Or does Baron Green think the gift I brought is not significant enough?"
He snapped his fingers.
